config_schema.description: Config accepted by every `computer::*` trigger binding. The only filter is an optional session-id equality match; unknown fields fail at registration so a misspelled filter key fails loudly instead of silently receiving nothing.

session_id.description: Only deliver events for this computer session.

config_schema.title: BindingConfig

description: A caller drove a desktop session (computer::act or computer::run); the console's live preview shows that session.

payload_schema.description: `computer::activity` — a caller drove a session: fired when a `computer::act` call reaches it, or a `computer::run` passed its checks and holds it.
payload_schema.title: ActivityEvent
